name: Mira
greeting: Those will keep. Thank you. Most people offer to kill something when I ask for help.
lines: Kael: I know a useful knot as well.
Mira: An alarming range of talents. Leave the bundles here. I'll take them round when the fever breaks.

actions.label: I'll leave you to it. Keep me a little company next time.

relationship_event.text: Kael and Mira shared ordinary garden work. Neither made a romantic promise.
relationship_event.acknowledgement: No damp stems today. Sit for a moment; I can spare that much.
